newsitem.title: INDIA: Reliance drags Delhi stocks lower.
newsitem.headline: Reliance drags Delhi stocks lower.

text.p: Delhi shares drifted lower in early trading on Monday as Reliance Industries continued to lose ground on profit-taking, brokers said.
After 30 minutes of trading, the Delhi Stock Exchange's benchmark index was down 1.80 points at 882.02.
"The market has started showing a two-way movement, as both buyers and sellers are adopting a cautious apprroach," S.C. Juneja of brokers Jaico Credit (Pvt) Ltd said.
Brokers said foreign institutional investors made selective purchases, driving some stocks higher, while the largest mutual fund, the Unit Trust of India sold selective stocks.
State Bank of India fell 3.45 rupees to 339.50.
Hindustan Lever dropped six rupees to 1,389.
Hero Honda Motors Ltd gained 3.40 rupees to 501.
